blocks.text: Sabz cells mein roshni (light) ki maujoodgi mein hone wali woh respiration jaisi sargarmi jis mein carbon dioxide nikalti hai, photorespiration kehlati hai. Aerobic respiration ki tarah is mein oxygen lagti hai aur CO₂ aur H₂O bante hain. Lekin photorespiration mein ATP nahin banta.

blocks.title: Yaad karein
blocks.text: Carbon fixation ke dauran rubisco CO₂ ke teen molecules ko RuBP ke teen molecules se jor kar 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) ke chhe molecules banata hai.
